data.cultural_impact: The name Antonino has its roots in the Roman Empire, where it was a popular name among the nobility. It was especially associated with the Roman Emperor Antoninus Pius, who ruled from 138 to 161 AD. Antoninus Pius was known for his wisdom, fairness, and tolerance, making the name synonymous with leadership and nobility in ancient Roman culture.
